If you are looking for a fitness center that balances a professional environment with a welcoming community feel, I will surely recommend Flex Iron Gym (Vikhroli West).

Standout points are:
1. Expert and Friendly Staff: One of the highlights of this gym is the staff. Trainer Sukanya, in particular has a very friendly nature and approachable attitude. Having a trainer who is supportive makes a huge difference, especially on days when your motivation is low.

2. Well-Equipped Facilities: The gym is stocked with high-quality, well-maintained machines. Whether you are focused on heavy strength training or functional movements, you’ll find the right tools for your workout.

3. Fair Cardio Policy: To ensure every member gets a fair chance to work on their heart health, the gym has a 15-minute limit on cardio machines during peak times. This helps every member to get a fair chance to do their cardio.

4. Gym Vibe: The gym maintains a high standard of hygiene and has a high-energy vibe that keeps you focused on your goals.

featured_reviews.name: Anj Illustrator
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this gym recently after a long break, and the experience was disappointing. There was no receptionist, and the system was not working. Instead of handling this professionally, the coach Sukanya assumed I did not have a valid membership and asked for a screenshot of my payment. Even after I showed the bill, she said that my admission was taken by another trainer (Ashwini) and that she needed to “cross-check,” which felt like poor internal coordination and unnecessary doubt placed on the member.

As someone returning after a break, I expected at least basic guidance or a welcoming attitude, but the behavior was rude and unprofessional.

I was doing cardio on the treadmill, and although no one was waiting to use it, I was asked to step down immediately after 15 minutes, without any flexibility and in a very rude manner.

Overall, the environment feels uncomfortable, and the trainers seem focused mainly on personal training. Members who don’t opt for PT are not treated well. Due to similar behavior, my sister shifted from this women’s gym to a unisex gym, where professionalism and member treatment are much better.

I was planning to extend my membership, but after this experience, I won’t be doing so. I hope the management improves staff coordination, professionalism, and customer handling.

I had severe sciatica pain to the extent that I couldn’t walk. With her guidance, awareness-based training, and consistent work, the pain has now reduced to once in a while. Shivani doesn’t just train the body; she understands pain, movement, and mindset deeply. I’m extremely grateful for her support, patience, and commitment to long-term well-being. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for sustainable, pain-free movement and true healing.

Shivani has this calm yet powerful presence. She doesn’t just give instructions - she pays attention, understands what your body is doing, and helps you move better with real, lasting improvements. Her inputs not just help in improving physical health but overall mental health too. She meets you at your pace - never rushed, always encouraging, and always precise.

Pranay, on the other hand, is all energy and precision. He has a knack for designing workouts that pushes you right to your edge, but never over it. There’s a sense of discipline and fun at the same time; you leave exhausted but truly proud of yourself.

Never thought I’d look forward to every session or feel guilty for missing one. If you’re looking for trainers who truly get it - who care, who adapt, and who push you the right way, then Sculptasse is the right place.

He guided me not just with workouts but also with a proper diet plan and constant motivation. At times, his guidance felt like lectures—but now I realize their true value. Even though I’ve implemented only 5% of what he has taught me, I can already see a major transformation in my life. I can only imagine what I can achieve if I follow it 100%.

What is even more frustrating is that some of the machines that were fully functional when memberships were sold are now out of order. It is difficult to understand how a gym can justify charging members for facilities that are no longer available for use.
The gym has also been facing water seepage issues for over a year. Instead of addressing the root cause, a temporary tarpaulin sheet has been installed on the ceiling. Water still drips through during workouts, creating both inconvenience and safety concerns for members.
Running a gym undoubtedly involves significant costs, and members can appreciate that. However, consistently ignoring customer complaints and failing to maintain basic standards is unacceptable.
